notes:
### Dorcel Final Recovery Refinement

- When Kodi is cache-empty and an HTTP-200 Dorcel manifest has remained unchanged for at least 15 seconds, Adult TV Test now prepares a validated shadow session in the background without restarting normal SOURCE_WINDOW playback.
- This makes a fresh browser-style session available earlier if the stale window develops into a real 404/timeout outage, while leaving ordinary five-minute source windows unchanged.

### Post-Recovery Health

- Post-recovery health checks now also treat recent OutputPicture timeouts, audio-renderer timeouts, audio-stream stalls and large ActiveAE A/V-sync errors as unhealthy player evidence.
- A player carrying significant A/V-sync debt can therefore no longer be marked healthy simply because the manifest and cache have recovered; an already prepared shadow session can be used to cut off the remaining Kodi tail when needed.

### Important

- Normal five-minute SOURCE_WINDOW thresholds, live-delay behavior and the planned hourly Dorcel handoff remain unchanged.
- Existing shadow recovery, clean Stop -> idle -> Start behavior, Wi-Fi diagnostics, outage counters, Auto Channels Check, Site/IPTV behavior, One Channel, automatic log saving, Save Log Only, Shutdown/Sleep, Check Lock and watchdog remain otherwise unchanged.
